Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife, former National
Assembly President Cilia Flores, are expected back in U.S. court Wednesday as
they face criminal prosecution over their alleged participation in a decades-
long drug trafficking operation.

This hearing comes just six months after Donald Trump's administration
[kidnapped](https://zeteo.com/p/venezuela-attack-trump-maduro-oil) Maduro and
Flores in Venezuela as part of an unprecedented regime change operation,
setting the stage for a lengthy and complicated legal battle ahead.
